items.title: NIH Grant Funds Project to Revolutionize Care For Older Adults
items.summary: By Patty Guerra, UC Merced November 5, 2026 The system can alert caretakers to issues before they become larger problems. Researchers from UC Merced and UC Davis are putting into practice work aimed at helping older adults maintain independence where they live while providing loved ones and caretakers with real-time updates on their health . items.title: Summit at UC Merced Takes Aim at Preserving Grasslands
items.summary: By Patty Guerra, UC Merced October 29, 2026 The state is working to support the restoration of grasslands, Agriculture Secretary Karen Ross said. Photo by Sara Nevis California's grasslands are a vital part of a healthy ecosystem, supporting native plants and endangered animal species.
